description: This PHP script manages banner impression trackers within the Revive Adserver platform, including form handling, URL validation, and database updates for video banner impression trackers.

classes.name: OA_Admin_UI_Component_Form
classes.description: Form class used to build and handle the banner trackers form.

classes.name: OA_Admin_Template
classes.description: Template class used for rendering HTML templates.

classes.name: OA_Permission
classes.description: Permission management class for access control.

classes.name: OA_Dal
classes.description: Data Access Layer class for database interactions.

methods.name: buildBannerTrackersMediaForm
methods.description: Creates a form for editing banner impression trackers.

methods.name: processForm
methods.description: Processes submitted form data, updates database, and redirects.

methods.name: displayPage
methods.description: Displays the form page with navigation and footer.

methods.name: splitUrls
methods.description: Splits multiline text into an array of URLs.

methods.description: Validates URLs to ensure they start with http or https.
